== Biography ==
'''Sarah Glasgow''' was baptised at Irvine, Ayrshire, on 3 July 1726. The parish register names her parents as John Glasgow and Agnes Ferguson.<ref name="FMP1" /> Because the entry records a baptism rather than a birth, her birth is placed before that date, and Irvine is inferred from the baptism rather than independently recorded.

The repeated father and mother names tie Sarah to the Irvine household of [[Glasgow-1077|John Glasgow MA]] and [[Ferguson-15168|Agnes Ferguson]], whose other children were baptised in the same parish in this period, her brother [[Glasgow-1139|John Glasgow]] among them. The attachment to those parents remains uncertain pending a record with a second identifier.

== Research Notes ==

Recorded adult John/Agnes household; neither inferred birthplace nor uncertain sex wording weakens the named father clause.

Next useful test: Find John/Agnes marriage or probate tying this family to the 1690 Kilbirnie child.
